items.summary: Charles River Laboratories’ virtual control group (VCG) database will be used in a toxicology study run by French biopharma company Ipsen.

items.title: Madrigal’s former clinical development head files whistleblower lawsuit alleging Rezdiffra safety cover-up
items.summary: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals is facing a whistleblower lawsuit alleging that senior leadership censored serious liver-injury data related to its breakthrough MASH drug Rezdiffra and retaliated against the firm’s top clinical development head who tried to sound the alarm.

items.title: Smith+Nephew held failed talks with J&J over potential orthopedics combination
items.summary: Smith+Nephew held talks with Johnson & Johnson’s hip-and-knee replacement unit DePuy Synthes aimed at a potential combination with its orthopedics unit.

items.title: Minghui grants ASKA Japanese rights to sub-q TED candidate in $440M deal
items.summary: China’s Minghui Pharmaceutical has licensed its late-stage thyroid eye disease candidate to ASKA Pharmaceutical for up to $440 million, granting the Japanese drugmaker exclusive development and commercialization rights in its home country.

items.title: Blackstone Life Sciences teams up with Boston Scientific in $455M heart pump deal
items.summary: Blackstone Life Sciences has penned a $455 million collaboration with Boston Scientific to co-fund the development of the medtech’s next-generation miniature heart pump system.

items.title: Boehringer returns to Sino Biopharma in $7.4B deal for preclinical TCEs, ADCs
items.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has returned to China to satisfy its appetite for antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers.

items.title: nPhase rakes in $30M to expand AI-native clinical data platform
items.summary: Clinical research company nPhase has closed a $30 million series D financing round to expand its AI-native clinical data platform.

items.title: AbbVie pens $1.4B deal for deprioritized IBD drug from Nxera
items.summary: AbbVie has added another angle to its relationship with Nxera, with the Big Pharma paying $100 million upfront for a phase 1 inflammatory bowel disease candidate.

items.title: Ultragenyx shrinks workforce and axes assets to halve R&D spend
items.summary: Ultragenyx is laying off 20% of its workforce and axing drug development programs to cut its annual R&D budget to half of the amount it spent in 2025.

items.title: Actor Jeremy Pope joins ViiV's 'PrEP Wisdom' campaign to educate on long-acting PrEP options
items.summary: ViiV Healthcare has tapped a new mind for its “PrEP Wisdom” campaign, with Tony Award-winning actor and fashion icon Jeremy Pope joining in on the education and awareness messaging around long-acting injectable pre-exposure prophylaxis options.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo sets new Rx record as Wegovy pill rebounds to prior high
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: J&J pushes Rybrevant beyond lung cancer with new subQ FDA nod
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.
